review_method: Numeric re-measurement only: the checkout size and its date change; wording is the reviewed 2026-09-24 translation. Native-speaker signoff not claimed.

records.label: dated-clone-and-current-checkout-size
records.source: On 2026-09-15, the full clone downloaded 5.8 GB. Adding ``--filter=blob:none`` to the shallow clone did not reduce its measured download. The nightly tracked tree is a 821 MB checkout (measured 2026-09-26), excluding Git history. Download sizes and times vary with the branch.
records.translation: Na medição de 2026-09-15, o clone completo baixou 5,8 GB. No clone raso, ``--filter=blob:none`` não reduziu o download medido. Os arquivos versionados de nightly ocupam 821 MB na cópia de trabalho (medidos em 2026-09-26), sem o histórico do Git. O tamanho e o tempo de download variam conforme a ramificação.
